title: polygala vulgaris var. alpestris
intro: Polygala vulgaris var. alpestris, commonly known as alpine polygala, is a plant species belonging to the family Polygalaceae. It is a perennial herb native to mountainous regions of Europe, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant is said to possess adaptogenic and immunomodulatory properties, which may help to alleviate stress and boost the immune system. Bioactive constituents of alpine polygala include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
